thesis: Build a rebirth arc that rises from dark introspection to luminous uplift, using progressive widening geometry and warm-white confirmations to make the title feel earned.

artist_branding.summary: Blooom and Wolfy Lights read as melodic, emotionally direct electronic artists: cinematic builds, vocal-forward warmth, and modern pop-leaning euphoric release rather than industrial darkness.
visual_cues: Introvert-to-euphoric intensity ramps with clear phrase contrast
Clean melodic beam lanes with emotional color lifts on hooks
Contemporary polished palette treatment with restrained saturation
do_not_copy: Avoid copying exact social promo edit timing, cover-art compositions, or one-to-one choreography from official clips.

motifs: Geometry motif: center-locked starts that gradually expand into full-room orbits
Color motif: midnight blue and violet foundation opening into teal, amber, and warm white
Movement motif: longer fades in introspective phrases and tighter rhythmic pushes in chorus peaks

visual_direction.color_story: Start with deep cool tones, add hopeful amber in transitions, and reserve warm white for the clearest rebirth moments.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use gradual kinetic growth across sections: contained center breathing first, then broader and faster lateral travel in high-energy phrases.
visual_direction.staging_story: Let PAR layers carry emotional bed color while movers narrate transformation through repeated returns to a brighter center state.

must_include: At least one low-density pre-rise section before first major release
Distinct phrase-level contrast between verse and chorus/drop families
A visible late-show brightening payoff that justifies the rebirth concept
avoid: Constant maximum-output treatment from the start
Unbroken strobe walls that hide melodic phrasing
Random color cycling that ignores narrative progression
